project.name: Queue status UI
project.brief: Allocate coherent pixel-art Working, Ready, Retry and Paused status assets for shared 16x16 queue cells while preserving the existing Start vector. Review a representative sample before family expansion; this allocation performs no asset generation.

included: Read BRIEF.md and SOURCE-MAP.md in full; re-read the changed brief, queue-state and queue-view source for this refresh.
Resolve the local ./queue type import and trace started/ok/error/pause through stateAfter to running/succeeded/failed/paused visual descriptors.
Trace both statusCell and compactStatus to the same statusVisuals map; allocate one shared asset per status rather than duplicate assets per consumer.
Inspect the only checked-in art, assets/start.svg, at source level for shape, dimensions and accent; verify the four current PNG destinations are absent.
Reconcile the Retry destination move to assets/error-retry.png while preserving its queue.retry ID and unchanged failure/retry purpose.
Capture unchanged display.cell, scale, nearest filtering, frameMs and dark-panel color from the supplied view descriptor.

Current refresh: re-read BRIEF.md line 9 and src/queue-view.ts; retain queue.ready ID while moving its destination to assets/ready-confirmed.png and promoting the explicitly required asymmetrical-arm check mark. Other states and Start unchanged.

Render stage: ran renderer/capture.mjs (HeadlessChrome 156, DPR 1) against the actual src/queue.ts and src/queue-view.ts for every statusVisuals state in both statusCell and compactStatus at 1x and 3x; checked identities, canvas pixels, alpha compositing and nearest blocks with renderer/check.py; inspected the retained PNGs visually.
excluded: Server-registry account badges returned by accountBadge are explicitly outside this local request; do not allocate replacement badge art.
No images are allocated for stateAfter or other functions without a visual role; the queue transitions determine status meaning only.
No new Start control, panel background, font, text label, host configuration, generated art or provider operation is assigned.
unresolved: The representative renderer in renderer/ is a scoped browser fixture that imports the real view modules; it is not the production UI, and its headless screenshot is laid out at the 1280 px window width while DOM bounds are measured at the 1262 px viewport, so renderer/check.py reports a 9 px horizontal offset (see queue.ready evidence). Production-host display acceptance remains unverified.

Style baseline: the delivered Ready fixture is a controlled pixellab-test sample (provider_simulated=true). Adopting it as the family style reference establishes edge treatment, stroke weight, fill/colour role, margin and alpha policy only; it does not establish the other members' silhouettes, motion or meaning, nor actual PixelLab output quality.
The account badge registry is populated remotely and is not enumerable from this checkout; badges remain excluded.

Working, Retry and Paused have no artwork, no production store, no candidate and no review; timed loop playback at 100 ms can only be observed interactively (node renderer/server.mjs) because the capture samples frame boundaries, not real-time playback.
